goal: Apply the shared 48px touch-target token, honest accessibility selection/disabled states, and static reduced-motion behavior to reused A2UI controls.
successCriteria: Interactive shared icon/chip/chat/nav controls use the minimum touch target; decorative avatars keep their size.
Chip selected, Ritual disabled, date navigation labels and calendar date selection are exposed to screen readers.
Fade and thinking indicator are static until OS preference is known and stop when reduced motion is enabled.
Existing A2UI tests and TypeScript pass; responsive mobile browser checks are recorded separately from native acceptance.
untouchedSurfaces: No App.tsx, data, billing, backend or Admin edits.
Calendar day grid preserves non-overlapping narrow-screen columns; 48px height and explicit labels/selection are implemented, narrow widths remain a disclosed native review item.

impact.entryPoint: Shared headers, chips, buttons, chat composer/thinking status, date-picker and navigation used across mobile flows.
impact.dataWrite: No persistent data change; only OS motion preference subscription and existing UI interaction callbacks.
impact.backendContract: No API, storage or provider changes.
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin data or UI change.
impact.privacySafety: No private data capture; readable status and selected/disabled state remain available when animation is off.
impact.observability: No new telemetry; reduced-motion updates cancel running decorative animations.
impact.rollback: Revert scoped shared component patch against reviewed dirty baseline; public prop signatures remain compatible.

canonicalContracts: Existing TarotStage, reading.cards/sourceSnapshot and canonical card meanings are preserved; explanation is displayed seed/context, not provider-private reasoning.
Open Reflection v1 and current A2UI/brand guidelines govern typography and artwork placement.
